svg.title: AI Error Explainer: how it works
svg.desc: VS Code extension that explains errors on hover in your language. Setup in four steps, a live hover demo that switches languages, and nine supported AI providers.

g.text: Hover over any error. Get a plain-language fix, in your language.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','Fira Code',Consolas,Menlo,monospace

g.text: Get it from the VS Code Marketplace.
Gemini and Claude need only a key.
Others also take a Base URL and model.
Paste your API key, choose one of 41
